audience_question: Which retrofit barrier is most common overall, and did service turnaround improve?
form: evidence readout with source-separated comparison and answerability callout
fit_rationale: A source-separated two-panel readout preserves North's overlapping survey counts and South's distinct case-review unit while making the limits on overall ranking and turnaround change explicit. A shared footer states the comparable data needed to answer both parts.
tradeoff: The slide prioritizes comparability and caveats over a single cross-partner ranking or trend visual, which the evidence cannot support.
caveats: North allowed multiple selections, so its barrier counts overlap and exceed 40; its within-survey leading listed barrier does not establish the overall leader.
South reviewed 15 open cases, not a reported count of all homeowners served; 9 mentioned installer wait and other barriers were not systematically recorded.
South's 8-day median covers 11 cases; four cases lacked times.
The 'around two weeks last spring' note has no identified cases, sample size, or method and is not comparable to the recent median.
The partners have no shared period definition or common denominator.
